name: Runner Tests Fixture - Session User Windows SID Plain
brief: #2352: a bundle that touches nothing about the session user sees the runner-generated Windows SID, after an earlier bundle in the same process moved Sid() onto a row of its own.
description: The cross-bundle control for the Windows SID. SessionUserRowNameCollision adopts a row whose Windows Security ID is blank and SessionUserRowAlreadyPresent blanks the seeded row's, so Sid() is '' in both; this bundle, run after them in one process, must see S-1-5-21-1413829460-1431520594-0-1000 again, because the skeleton NavUser is built once per process and its windowsSID is poked per bundle. Nothing in a single-bundle run can observe the difference.
